name: MLflow
oneLine: Open-source platform for tracing, evaluating and managing LLM applications, agents and ML models; Linux Foundation project.

selfHostStack.value: Tracking server (FastAPI) plus a SQL backend store (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MSSQL) and an artifact store such as S3

selfHostLicence.value: Apache 2.0, fully open source; no paid tier of the self-hosted code

cloudFree.value: No hosted tier on mlflow.org; docs point to a Databricks free trial for managed MLflow (trial credits)

cloudPaidFrom.value: No managed price on mlflow.org; managed MLflow is sold by Databricks

otel.value: OTLP/HTTP at /v1/traces (needs SQL backend; gRPC not supported); maps GenAI, OpenInference, OpenLLMetry attributes

sql.value: Not documented: docs describe a SQL-like trace search filter (no OR) in the UI and API

mcp.value: Yes (experimental): search and get traces, set tags, log feedback and expectations, delete traces

onlineEvals.value: Yes: automatic evaluation runs LLM judges on traces as they arrive; needs an AI Gateway endpoint; LLM judges only

datasetsExperiments.value: Yes: evaluation datasets (SQL backend required) and mlflow.genai.evaluate runs with comparison

promptManagement.value: Yes: Prompt Registry with immutable versions, aliases, UI and API

gateway.value: Yes: AI Gateway, one endpoint for multiple LLM providers with routing, failover, rate limits, budgets

alerts.value: Gateway budget policies send webhook alerts; registry webhooks exist; trace alerts not documented

issueDetection.value: Issue Detection groups findings from experiment traces, using a model you choose, into issues; on demand or scheduled

annotationQueues.value: Review queues: traces assigned to reviewers with questions; experimental, added in MLflow 3.14.0

assistant.value: AI Assistant: chat panel on experiment pages; backed by Claude Code or Codex CLI, Ollama or a gateway; debugs traces

codingAgents.value: Tracing for Claude Code (hooks), Codex (notify hook) and Gemini CLI (OpenTelemetry)

chooseThem: Covers LLM tracing, evaluation, prompt registry, AI gateway and classic ML experiment tracking in one tool
Apache 2.0 licence with no paid tier of the self-hosted code
Runs on a database you already operate (PostgreSQL, MySQL) with object storage for artifacts
Managed MLflow is available through Databricks
notes: cloudPaidFrom Unknown: mlflow.org does not list managed MLflow prices; managed MLflow is offered by Databricks, whose pricing I did not fetch. The Databricks trial page gives no duration or credit amount. 'sql' and 'alerts' are absence-style claims ('not documented'/'not found'), based on the docs I read, not an exhaustive search. Automatic-evaluation page does not state whether OSS or Databricks only. Some docs pages (MCP, AI Gateway, mcp-registry) are in the master docs; the mlflow.org/latest web versions may lag the repo (checkout dated 2026-11-09). Stars/downloads figures from the site were not used. GitHub sources (gateway index, budget alerts, webhooks, attribute-mapping, docker-compose) were read in a local checkout, not on the web. Verified 2026-11-20: OTLP (HTTP only, SQL backend), MCP (experimental), automatic evaluation, prompt registry, architecture, gateway and webhooks confirmed (live pages/local docs). sql/alerts reworded to 'not documented'. chooseThem: removed unverified 'large community'; 'Linux Foundation' kept only in oneLine (not re-verified here; check before publishing); removed unverified 'many built-in judge scorers'. LICENSE.txt is Apache-licensed per local checkout header 'Copyright 2018 Databricks'. Added 2026-11-22: four new rows. Verifier 2026-11-22: assistant row reworded; the page lists Claude Code and Codex CLIs, Ollama and an MLflow AI Gateway endpoint as backends, not only a coding-agent CLI.
chooseUs: You want built-in alerts on error rate, cost, latency and scores
You want OTLP over gRPC as well as HTTP
